facts.text: I am working on a new project and need help organizing my ideas.
I want help brainstorming and prioritizing tasks for a new project.
On Tuesday, we discussed the new project during lunch and came up with great ideas.
I am developing a new marketing strategy for my company.
My company wants to increase its online presence.
On Tuesday, we talked about focusing on social media and content creation for the marketing strategy.
My company is a software development firm.
My company specializes in creating custom solutions for businesses.
My company is known for an innovative approach.
My company is committed to delivering high-quality products.
My company’s target audience is typically medium to large-sized businesses in various industries.
My content tone should be professional and friendly.
My content focus is building long-term relationships with clients.
I will start with case studies and technical blog posts.
I want a content calendar for the next quarter focused on case studies and technical blog posts.
I want to publish at least one case study per month.
I want to publish at least one technical blog post per month.
I want to focus on case studies first and then move on to technical blog posts.
For the case studies, I want help brainstorming potential titles and angles for each month.
I want the case study titles and angles to be relevant to the target audience.
I want the case studies to showcase my company’s expertise.
I especially like highlighting the benefits and results of custom software solutions.
I especially like sharing lessons learned and best practices.
For the April case study, I am thinking of focusing on a retailer in the fashion industry.
For the April case study, I want to explore how a custom software solution helped streamline inventory management.
For the April case study, I want to explore how a custom software solution reduced stockouts.
For the April case study, I want to explore how a custom software solution improved customer satisfaction.
I think focusing on the retailer in the fashion industry for the April case study is a good direction to take.
